# `get_fits_file`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch an image file from the device, optionally compressed.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit imager build: conditional diagnostics; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0x1f3480 (64-bit imager build); path rule: four image-folder substring checks, then concatenation with the image root; no realpath or ".." test |

Served by the imager process (4801). Params select a file by `name` and a `compress` flag. `name` is used as given if it contains a known image-folder name, otherwise it is taken relative to the image root; the device does not normalise the path or reject `..` components (READ), so confinement to the image store is not enforced (INFERRED). The reply is the file data, raw or zip-compressed (imgType 6), or a text error; file-size and file-read failures return a message. The compression path (subprocess, temporary file, native effects) is unresolved, as is the compress default on each build.

Side effects: Writes native diagnostic output. Further file, image, database and compression effects are unresolved (tier D).

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_fits_file"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | no | - | File name and compress flag, as an object or as a positional array [name, compress]. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | name missing or not a string | `expected string param` |
| 258 | File cannot be opened or read (condition INFERRED from the code's text) | `open file failed` |

## Example

Request, object-form:

```json
{"id":41,"method":"get_fits_file","params":{"name":"example.fit","compress":true}}
```

Request, array-form:

```json
{"id":42,"method":"get_fits_file","params":["example.fit",0]}
```
